firstObservedLimit: One separate process per first-observed profile and variant in each comparison. Includes first family fixture construction,JIT,metadata and the real public wrapper. Not whole-process startup or isolated cache-entry cost; descriptive cold observations,not a statistically established production-latency claim.
normalProcessRequirement: MetadataUpdater.IsSupported=false for all measured profiles. Actual update-enabled behavior is independently validated by the real watcher.
variantControl: One compiled harness,179-file native consumer closure. Swap only the captured actual MVC owner DLL and matching PDB;verify every file before and after each native profile. Prove matching PE/PDB content identity and source-document checksums in each process.
machineControl: Shared Windows VM,not isolated. Observe and preserve process/thread priority and affinity. Reuse the byte-exact direct RunnableProgram executor. Guid.Empty power plan;no settings setters.
comparisons: Alternate warm variant order original/selected,selected/original,original/selected. Retain all14 public/helper rows and first-observed controls,including unfavorable results.
accounting: Consume one slot before any warm or first-observed timing. Failed or partial timing consumes the slot. Unmeasured producer,resource,lifetime and watcher checks consume no timing slot.
earlyStop: Only after a clear at-least50-percent improvement in the predeclared public primary profiles,with compatible public results and retained control/cold costs. A helper-only win cannot authorize early stop. Otherwise evaluate up to3 actual comparisons.
publication: A proposal requires a repeatable public-boundary improvement,including material allocation savings if timing remains uncertain. Report timing uncertainty explicitly. Otherwise publish no-gain/rejected evidence without manufacturing a draft.
